newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Lebed to attend Clinton inauguration.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Lebed to attend Clinton inauguration.

text.p: Russian presidential hopeful Alexander Lebed said on Tuesday he would attend U.S. President Bill Clinton's inauguration ceremony, Russia's commercial NTV news reported.
It quoted the tough-talking retired general as saying at the start of a five-day visit to Germany that he had accepted an invitation to attend the ceremony next Monday.
Lebed has predicted an early election will be held because of President Boris Yeltsin's ill health and declared he will take the Kremlin seat from the 65-year-old president.
Lebed, 46, is tipped as a potential successor to Yeltsin, who is facing a seventh day in hospital recovering from pneumonia two months after a quintuple heart bypass operation.
